description: A consumer's integration with Nextcloud: which Nextcloud connector it is.

connector.description: The Nextcloud integration this consumer provides. update-service.sh re-applies 'onlyoffice' (the ADR-COM-0002 document-server wiring for euro-office); 'talk' (coturn) and 'hpb' (nextcloud-hpb) name the consumer's role and are not re-applied by this service.
connector.changeNote: Which connector the consumer is. update-service.sh reconciles the onlyoffice wiring on every run; changing the value changes what that reconcile does, with no guest downtime.

values.onlyoffice: Document editor (euro-office): DocumentServerUrl/StorageUrl + JWT into the onlyoffice app.
values.talk: TURN/STUN relay (coturn): the shared TURN secret and the coturn turnHost into Talk's stun/turn servers (/etc/secrets/talk.env → nextcloud-configure-talk-turn.service).
values.hpb: Talk High-Performance Backend (nextcloud-hpb): the signaling secret and wss:// URL into Talk's signaling servers (/etc/secrets/hpb.env → nextcloud-configure-hpb.service).

nextcloudPublicUrl.description: Nextcloud's PUBLIC base URL (https://<proxyDomain>), stamped into the consumer's deployed config by nextcloud:fileservice so the consumer's .nix can read it from its companion JSON. The HPB's signaling server validates Talk against this exact URL (an internal name is rejected with invalid_backend).
nextcloudPublicUrl.note: Stamped, never authored. Re-derived on every update of the consumer.
nextcloudPublicUrl.changeNote: A fact about the provider, refreshed on every converge.
